name: oidc-caep-client-api-docs
description: Generates the API references for the documentation site: TypeDoc (the TypeScript view, from the JSDoc types) and JSDoc. A package of its own, outside the npm workspace, because TypeDoc runs on TypeScript 6 and the library builds its declarations with TypeScript 7, the native compiler, which has no JavaScript API for TypeDoc to call. iya-sts does the same (tests/tools/jsdoc).

scripts.build: npm run typedoc && npm run jsdoc
